svg.aria-label: Rare positives: five treatments, one trap
svg.text: Rare positives: five treatments, one trap
A 2.5% positive class, scored on the same test set
mean predicted probability: plain 0.0243, class weights 0.2857,
oversampling 0.2817, against a true rate of 0.0255
reweighting slides the operating point and inflates probabilities
at 2% the model is wrong 9 times in 10 when it alerts
A decision ladder: stop when the problem is solved
recalibrate if you need probabilities; more real positives beats every trick
